tool_signatures.name: Description
tool_signatures.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

tool_signatures.name: Description
tool_signatures.description: Start recording actions that the user performs in the browser as Playwright code. Use it when the user wants to demonstrate a flow manually. Call browser_stop_recording when the user says they are done to retrieve the recorded actions.

tool_signatures.description: Annotate subsequent actions performed on the page with a callout that names the action and, when styled, marks the action point and highlights the target element. Useful while video recording or screencasting.

tool_signatures.name: accessibleName (string)
tool_signatures.description: ACCESSIBLE_NAME of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: - role "{ACCESSIBLE_NAME}"

tool_signatures.name: all (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

tool_signatures.name: boxes (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

tool_signatures.name: button (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Button to click, defaults to left

tool_signatures.name: code (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }

tool_signatures.name: cursor (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Render an animated mouse cursor that travels to each action point. Paces actions by 800ms so that the cursor has time to travel.

tool_signatures.name: cursor (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Cursor decoration for pointer actions. "pointer" (default) animates a mouse pointer from the previous action point to the next one; "none" disables the cursor decoration.

tool_signatures.name: data (object, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Data to drop, as a map of MIME type to string value .

tool_signatures.name: delay (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Time to wait between mouse down and mouse up in milliseconds, defaults to 0

tool_signatures.name: depth (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

tool_signatures.name: doubleClick (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

tool_signatures.name: duration (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Duration in milliseconds to show the chapter card

tool_signatures.name: duration (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: How long each action annotation stays on screen, in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the console messages to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, messages are returned as text.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, result is returned as text.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Save results to a file instead of returning them in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, output is returned as text.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the network requests to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Load code from the specified file. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Save snapshot to a file instead of returning it in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the screenshot is saved into the output directory as page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the storage state to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the storage state is saved into the output directory as storage-state-{timestamp}.json.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the video to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the video is saved into the output directory as video-{timestamp}.webm.

tool_signatures.name: filename (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: File name to save the pdf to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the pdf is saved into the output directory as page-{timestamp}.pdf.

tool_signatures.name: filter (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.user").

tool_signatures.name: fps (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Video frame rate in frames per second, defaults to 25

tool_signatures.name: fullPage (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

tool_signatures.name: function (string)
tool_signatures.description: () => { / code / } or (element) => { / code / } when element is provided

tool_signatures.name: headers (array, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Headers to add in "Name: Value" format

tool_signatures.name: httpOnly (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Whether the cookie is HTTP only

tool_signatures.name: index (integer)
tool_signatures.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

tool_signatures.name: index (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

tool_signatures.name: key (string)
tool_signatures.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as ArrowLeft or a

tool_signatures.name: level (string)
tool_signatures.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

tool_signatures.name: location (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Pause execution at a specific <file>:<line>, e.g. "example.spec.ts:42".

tool_signatures.name: media (optional)
tool_signatures.description: Changes the CSS media type of the page

tool_signatures.name: part (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

tool_signatures.name: paths (array, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

tool_signatures.name: paths (array, optional)
tool_signatures.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tool_signatures.name: pattern (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: URL pattern to unroute (omit to remove all routes)

tool_signatures.name: position (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Where to place the action title relative to the page. Defaults to top-right.

tool_signatures.name: promptText (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tool_signatures.name: regex (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

tool_signatures.name: removeHeaders (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Comma-separated list of header names to remove from request

tool_signatures.name: role (string)
tool_signatures.description: ROLE of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: - {ROLE} "Accessible Name":

tool_signatures.name: scale (string)
tool_signatures.description: Image resolution scale. "css" produces a screenshot sized in CSS pixels (smaller, consistent across devices). "device" produces a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (larger, accounts for the device pixel ratio). Default is css.

tool_signatures.name: slowly (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

tool_signatures.name: startElement (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

tool_signatures.name: startTarget (string)
tool_signatures.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tool_signatures.name: state (string)
tool_signatures.description: Set to "offline" to simulate offline mode, "online" to restore network connectivity

tool_signatures.name: static (boolean)
tool_signatures.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

tool_signatures.name: step (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: When true, execution will pause again before the next action, allowing step-by-step debugging.

tool_signatures.name: style (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Additional inline CSS applied to the highlight overlay, e.g. "outline: 2px dashed red".

tool_signatures.name: submit (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

tool_signatures.name: target (string)
tool_signatures.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector
